subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Afternoon Tea Invented
description: A 60-second lesson on Afternoon Tea Invented.

hook.text: In the 1840s, Anna Russell, Duchess of Bedford, felt a 'sinking feeling' every afternoon around four.

buildup.text: Dinner wasn't until eight. She asked servants to bring tea, bread, butter, and cakes to her room.

discovery.text: She began inviting friends. The informal gathering became fashionable among London's upper class.

twist.text: Afternoon tea and high tea are different. High tea is a working-class meal; afternoon tea is delicate snacks.

climax.text: Hotels like the Ritz and Claridge's turned afternoon tea into a grand event that tourists still flock to.

punchline.text: One duchess got hungry. A global tradition was born.

quiz.question: Who is credited with inventing afternoon tea?
